theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] (μ : Measure X) (ν : Measure Y) (f : X → Y) (A : Set X) (J : X → ℝ≥0∞), AEMeasurable J (μ.restrict A) → (∀ h : X → ℝ≥0∞, AEMeasurable h (μ.restrict A) → AEMeasurable (fun y => ∑' x : {x : X // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, h x) ν ∧ ∫⁻ x in A, h x * J x ∂μ = ∫⁻ y, ∑' x : {x : X // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, h x ∂ν) → ∀ g : X → ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable g (μ.restrict A) → ∫⁻ x in A, ‖g x‖ₑ * J x ∂μ < ∞ → (∀ᵐ y ∂ν, Summable (fun x : {x : X // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y} => g x)) ∧ Integrable (fun y => ∑' x : {x : X // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, g x) ν ∧ ∫ x in A, g x * (J x).toReal ∂μ = ∫ y, ∑' x : {x : X // x ∈ A ∧ f x = y}, g x ∂ν
